sections.text:
1640–49  English Civil War ──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
           Parliament vs. Crown; Cromwell leads New Model Army              │
           1649: Charles I executed (unprecedented)                         │
           1653: Cromwell as Lord Protector (de facto king)                 │
           1660: Restoration of Charles II — republic fails                 │
                                                                            │
  1688-89  Glorious Revolution / Bill of Rights ──────────────────────────┤
           Constitutional monarchy; Parliament supreme                      │
           Locke writes Two Treatises (theorizes consent of governed)       │
                                                                            │
  1775-83  American Revolution ────────────────────────────────────────────┤
           Jefferson drafts Declaration (Locke + Montesquieu)               │
           Washington manages the military coalition                        │
           1787: Constitutional Convention                                  │
           Hamilton + Madison write Federalist Papers                       │
           1789: Constitution ratified                                      │
                                                                            │
  1789-99  French Revolution ──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
           Estates-General → National Assembly → Terror                    │
           Robespierre: Committee of Public Safety; ~17,000 executed        │
           1794: Thermidor — Robespierre guillotined                        │
                                                                            │
  1799-1815  Napoleon ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
             Coup (18 Brumaire) → Consulate → Empire
             Codified law across Europe
             Ultimately defeated; but reforms survive him
